25	
26	  DyGIE++ (https://github.com/dwadden/dygiepp):
27	    Each line is a JSON object with keys: doc_key, dataset, sentences, ner, relations.
28	    - sentences: list[list[str]]  (tokenized)
29	    - ner:       list[list[[start, end, type]]]  per-sentence entity spans
30	    - relations: list[list[[h_start, h_end, t_start, t_end, type]]]
31	
32	  PURE (https://github.com/princeton-nlp/PURE):
33	    Each line is a JSON object with keys: doc_key, sentences, ner, relations.
34	    - sentences: list[list[str]]
35	    - ner:       list[list[[start, end, type]]]

37

39	"""
40	
41	import argparse
42	import json
43	import sys
44	from pathlib import Path
45	
46	import pandas as pd
47	
48	ACE05_ENTITY_TYPES = {"Person", "Organization", "GPE", "Location", "Facility", "Vehicle", "Weapon"}
49	
50	ACE05_RELATION_SUBTYPES = {
51	    "ART:User-Owner-Inventor-Manufacturer",
52	    "GEN-AFF:Citizen-Resident-Religion-Ethnicity", "GEN-AFF:Org-Location",
53	    "ORG-AFF:Employment", "ORG-AFF:Founder", "ORG-AFF:Membership",
54	    "ORG-AFF:Ownership", "ORG-AFF:Sports-Affiliation", "ORG-AFF:Student-Alum",
55	    "ORG-AFF:Investor-Shareholder",
56	    "PART-WHOLE:Artifact", "PART-WHOLE:Geographical", "PART-WHOLE:Subsidiary",
57	    "PER-SOC:Business", "PER-SOC:Family", "PER-SOC:Lasting-Personal",
58	    "PHYS:Located", "PHYS:Near",
59	}

61	
62	def _tokens_to_text(tokens):
63	    """Join tokens back into a string, preserving rough character offsets."""
64	    return " ".join(tokens)

66	
67	def parse_dygie(input_path, mode):
68	    """Parse DyGIE++ JSON-lines format."""
69	    records = []
70	    with open(input_path) as f:
71	        for line in f:
72	            doc = json.loads(line.strip())
73	            sentences = doc["sentences"]
74	            ner_per_sent = doc.get("ner", [[] for _ in sentences])
75	            rel_per_sent = doc.get("relations", [[] for _ in sentences])
76	
77	            flat_tokens = []
78	            sent_offsets = []
79	            for sent in sentences:
80	                sent_offsets.append(len(flat_tokens))
81	                flat_tokens.extend(sent)
82	
83	            for sent_idx, sent in enumerate(sentences):
84	                offset = sent_offsets[sent_idx]
85	                sent_text = _tokens_to_text(sent)
86	                sent_tokens = sent
87	
88	                entities = []
89	                ner_spans = ner_per_sent[sent_idx] if sent_idx < len(ner_per_sent) else []
90	                span_map = {}
91	                for span in ner_spans:
92	                    start, end, etype = span[0], span[1], span[2]
93	                    local_start = start - offset
94	                    local_end = end - offset
95	                    mention = " ".join(sent_tokens[local_start:local_end + 1])
96	                    entities.append({"text": mention, "type": etype})
97	                    span_map[(start, end)] = {"text": mention, "type": etype}
98	
99	                record = {"text": sent_text, "entities": entities}
100	
101	                if mode == "re":
102	                    relations = []
103	                    rel_spans = rel_per_sent[sent_idx] if sent_idx < len(rel_per_sent) else []
104	                    for rel in rel_spans:
105	                        h_start, h_end, t_start, t_end, rtype = rel[0], rel[1], rel[2], rel[3], rel[4]
106	                        head = span_map.get((h_start, h_end))
107	                        tail = span_map.get((t_start, t_end))
108	                        if head and tail:
109	                            relations.append({"head": head, "tail": tail, "type": rtype})
110	                    record["relations"] = relations
111	
112	                records.append(record)
113	
114	    return records
115	
116	
117	def parse_pure(input_path, mode):
118	    """Parse PURE JSON-lines format."""
119	    records = []
120	    with open(input_path) as f:
121	        for line in f:
122	            doc = json.loads(line.strip())
123	            sentences = doc["sentences"]
124	            ner_per_sent = doc.get("ner", [[] for _ in sentences])
125	            rel_per_sent = doc.get("relations", [[] for _ in sentences])
126	
127	            flat_tokens = []
128	            sent_offsets = []
129	            for sent in sentences:
130	                sent_offsets.append(len(flat_tokens))
131	                flat_tokens.extend(sent)
132	
133	            for sent_idx, sent in enumerate(sentences):

135	                sent_text = _tokens_to_text(sent)
136	                sent_tokens = sent
137	
138	                entities = []
139	                ner_spans = ner_per_sent[sent_idx] if sent_idx < len(ner_per_sent) else []
140	                span_map = {}
141	                for span in ner_spans:
142	                    start, end, etype = span[0], span[1], span[2]
143	                    local_start = start - offset
144	                    local_end = end - offset
145	                    mention = " ".join(sent_tokens[local_start:local_end + 1])
146	                    entities.append({"text": mention, "type": etype})
147	                    span_map[(start, end)] = {"text": mention, "type": etype}
148	
149	                record = {"text": sent_text, "entities": entities}
150	
151	                if mode == "re":
152	                    relations = []
153	                    rel_spans = rel_per_sent[sent_idx] if sent_idx < len(rel_per_sent) else []
154	                    for rel in rel_spans:
155	                        subj_start, subj_end = rel[0], rel[1]
156	                        obj_start, obj_end = rel[2], rel[3]
157	                        rtype = rel[4]
158	                        head = span_map.get((subj_start, subj_end))
159	                        tail = span_map.get((obj_start, obj_end))
160	                        if head and tail:
161	                            relations.append({"head": head, "tail": tail, "type": rtype})
162	                    record["relations"] = relations
163	
164	                records.append(record)
165	
166	    return records
167	
168	
169	def validate_records(records, mode):
170	    """Validate entity and relation types against ACE05 schema."""
171	    unknown_entity_types = set()
172	    unknown_relation_types = set()
173	    for r in records:
174	        for e in r["entities"]:
175	            if e["type"] not in ACE05_ENTITY_TYPES:
176	                unknown_entity_types.add(e["type"])
177	        if mode == "re":
178	            for rel in r.get("relations", []):

180	                    unknown_relation_types.add(rel["type"])

184	    if unknown_relation_types:

209

212	        rel_types = set()
213	        for r in records:

215	                rel_types.add(rel["type"])
216	        print(f"Relations: {n_relations} ({len(rel_types)} types)")

224	    parser.add_argument("--format", required=True, choices=["dygie", "pure"],

226	    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, help="Output parquet file path")
227	    parser.add_argument("--mode", default="ner", choices=["ner", "re"],

    "PER-SOC:Business", "PER-SOC:Family", "PER-SOC:Lasting-Personal",
    "PHYS:Located", "PHYS:Near",
}


def _tokens_to_text(tokens):
    """Join tokens back into a string, preserving rough character offsets."""
    return " ".join(tokens)


def parse_dygie(input_path, mode):
    """Parse DyGIE++ JSON-lines format."""
    records = []
    with open(input_path) as f:
        for line in f:
            doc = json.loads(line.strip())
            sentences = doc["sentences"]
            ner_per_sent = doc.get("ner", [[] for _ in sentences])
            rel_per_sent = doc.get("relations", [[] for _ in sentences])

            flat_tokens = []
            sent_offsets = []
            for sent in sentences:
                sent_offsets.append(len(flat_tokens))
                flat_tokens.extend(sent)

            for sent_idx, sent in enumerate(sentences):
                offset = sent_offsets[sent_idx]
                sent_text = _tokens_to_text(sent)
                sent_tokens = sent

                entities = []
                ner_spans = ner_per_sent[sent_idx] if sent_idx < len(ner_per_sent) else []
                span_map = {}
                for span in ner_spans:
                    start, end, etype = span[0], span[1], span[2]
                    local_start = start - offset
                    local_end = end - offset
                    mention = " ".join(sent_tokens[local_start:local_end + 1])
                    entities.append({"text": mention, "type": etype})
                    span_map[(start, end)] = {"text": mention, "type": etype}

                record = {"text": sent_text, "entities": entities}

                if mode == "re":
                    relations = []
                    rel_spans = rel_per_sent[sent_idx] if sent_idx < len(rel_per_sent) else []
                    for rel in rel_spans:
                        h_start, h_end, t_start, t_end, rtype = rel[0], rel[1], rel[2], rel[3], rel[4]
                        head = span_map.get((h_start, h_end))
                        tail = span_map.get((t_start, t_end))
                        if head and tail:
                            relations.append({"head": head, "tail": tail, "type": rtype})
                    record["relations"] = relations

                records.append(record)

    return records


def parse_pure(input_path, mode):
    """Parse PURE JSON-lines format."""
    records = []
    with open(input_path) as f:
        for line in f:
            doc = json.loads(line.strip())
            sentences = doc["sentences"]
            ner_per_sent = doc.get("ner", [[] for _ in sentences])
            rel_per_sent = doc.get("relations", [[] for _ in sentences])

            flat_tokens = []
            sent_offsets = []
            for sent in sentences:
                sent_offsets.append(len(flat_tokens))
                flat_tokens.extend(sent)

            for sent_idx, sent in enumerate(sentences):
                offset = sent_offsets[sent_idx]
                sent_text = _tokens_to_text(sent)
                sent_tokens = sent

                entities = []

                span_map = {}
                for span in ner_spans:
                    start, end, etype = span[0], span[1], span[2]

                    entities.append({"text": mention, "type": etype})

                record = {"text": sent_text, "entities": entities}

                if mode == "re":
                    relations = []
                    rel_spans = rel_per_sent[sent_idx] if sent_idx < len(rel_per_sent) else []
                    for rel in rel_spans:
                        subj_start, subj_end = rel[0], rel[1]
                        obj_start, obj_end = rel[2], rel[3]
                        rtype = rel[4]
                        head = span_map.get((subj_start, subj_end))
                        tail = span_map.get((obj_start, obj_end))
                        if head and tail:
                            relations.append({"head": head, "tail": tail, "type": rtype})

                records.append(record)

def validate_records(records, mode):
    """Validate entity and relation types against ACE05 schema."""
    unknown_entity_types = set()
    unknown_relation_types = set()
    for r in records:
        for e in r["entities"]:
            if e["type"] not in ACE05_ENTITY_TYPES:
                unknown_entity_types.add(e["type"])
        if mode == "re":
            for rel in r.get("relations", []):
                if rel["type"] not in ACE05_RELATION_SUBTYPES:
                    unknown_relation_types.add(rel["type"])

    if unknown_relation_types:
        print(f"WARNING: unknown relation types: {sorted(unknown_relation_types)}", file=sys.stderr)

    return len(unknown_entity_types) == 0 and len(unknown_relation_types) == 0


def to_parquet(records, output_path):
    """Write records list to parquet."""
    output_path = Path(output_path)
    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    df = pd.DataFrame(records)

def print_stats(records, mode):
    """Print dataset statistics."""
    n_entities = sum(len(r["entities"]) for r in records)
    entity_types = set()
    for r in records:
        for e in r["entities"]:
            entity_types.add(e["type"])

    print(f"Sentences: {len(records)}")
    print(f"Entities:  {n_entities} ({len(entity_types)} types)")

    if mode == "re":

        rel_types = set()
        for r in records:
            for rel in r.get("relations", []):
                rel_types.add(rel["type"])
        print(f"Relations: {n_relations} ({len(rel_types)} types)")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Convert ACE05 preprocessed data to parquet format"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--input", required=True, help="Input JSON-lines file (DyGIE++ or PURE format)")
    parser.add_argument("--format", required=True, choices=["dygie", "pure"],
                        help="Input format: dygie (DyGIE++) or pure (PURE)")
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, help="Output parquet file path")
    parser.add_argument("--mode", default="ner", choices=["ner", "re"],
                        help="Extraction mode: ner (entities only) or re (entities + relations)")
    parser.add_argument("--stats", action="store_true", help="Print dataset statistics after conversion")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if not Path(args.input).exists():
        print(f"ERROR: input file not found: {args.input}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

        sys.exit(1)

    validate_records(records, args.mode)
    to_parquet(records, args.output)

    if args.stats:
        print_stats(records, args.mode)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
MAVEN → parquet converter for schema-dag-extraction pipeline.

MAVEN data format (JSONL, one document per line):
  {
    "id": "doc_id",
    "title": "...",
    "content": [{"sentence": "...", "tokens": ["t1", "t2", ...]}, ...],
    "events": [
      {
        "id": "event_id",
        "type": "Killing",
        "type_id": 20,
        "mention": [
          {"id": "m_id", "trigger_word": "killed", "sent_id": 0, "offset": [3, 4]}
        ]
      }, ...
    ],
    "negative_triggers": [...]  // ignored
  }

Conversion logic:
  - Each document becomes one record (document-level, not sentence-level)
  - text = concatenation of all sentences separated by spaces
  - entities = list of {text: trigger_word, type: event_type} from all event mentions
  - Trigger word is reconstructed from token offsets for accuracy

Output: parquet with columns [text, entities] where entities is list[dict{text, type}].

Usage:
  python preprocess_maven.py --input_dir data/maven --output_dir data/maven_parquet --split train
  python preprocess_maven.py --input_dir data/maven --output_dir data/maven_parquet --split valid
  python preprocess_maven.py --help
"""

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd


SPLIT_FILE_MAP = {
    "train": "train.jsonl",
    "valid": "valid.jsonl",
    "test": "test.jsonl",
}


def extract_trigger_text(tokens, offset):
    """Reconstruct trigger text from token list and [start, end) offset."""
    start, end = offset
    if start < 0 or end > len(tokens):
        return None
    return " ".join(tokens[start:end])


def parse_document(doc):
    """Parse one MAVEN document into our record format.

    Returns dict with keys: text, entities.
    """
    sentences = doc.get("content", [])
    all_tokens_by_sent = []
    sent_texts = []
    for sent_obj in sentences:
        tokens = sent_obj.get("tokens", [])
        all_tokens_by_sent.append(tokens)
        sent_texts.append(sent_obj.get("sentence", " ".join(tokens)))

    full_text = " ".join(sent_texts)

    entities = []
    events = doc.get("events", [])
    for event in events:
        event_type = event["type"]
        for mention in event.get("mention", []):
            sent_id = mention["sent_id"]
            offset = mention["offset"]
            trigger_word = mention.get("trigger_word", "")

            if sent_id < len(all_tokens_by_sent):
                reconstructed = extract_trigger_text(all_tokens_by_sent[sent_id], offset)
                if reconstructed:
                    trigger_word = reconstructed

            if trigger_word:
                entities.append({"text": trigger_word, "type": event_type})

    return {"text": full_text, "entities": entities}


def process_split(input_path, output_path):
    """Read MAVEN JSONL and write parquet."""
    records = []
    with open(input_path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for line_num, line in enumerate(f, 1):
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:

            try:
                doc = json.loads(line)

                print(f"WARNING: skipping line {line_num}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
                continue
            record = parse_document(doc)
            records.append(record)

        sys.exit(1)

    output_path = Path(output_path)
    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    df = pd.DataFrame(records)
    df.to_parquet(output_path, index=False)

    n_entities = sum(len(r["entities"]) for r in records)
    event_types = set()
    for r in records:
        for e in r["entities"]:
            event_types.add(e["type"])

    print(f"Split: {input_path.name}")
    print(f"  Documents: {len(records)}")
    print(f"  Event mentions: {n_entities}")
    print(f"  Event types: {len(event_types)}")
    print(f"  Output: {output_path}")

        "--output_dir", required=True,
        help="Output directory for parquet files"

    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_dir = Path(args.input_dir)
    output_dir = Path(args.output_dir)

    if not input_dir.exists():
        print(f"ERROR: input directory not found: {input_dir}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    splits = list(SPLIT_FILE_MAP.keys()) if args.split == "all" else [args.split]

    for split in splits:
        filename = SPLIT_FILE_MAP[split]
        input_path = input_dir / filename
        if not input_path.exists():
            print(f"WARNING: {input_path} not found, skipping", file=sys.stderr)
            continue
        output_path = output_dir / f"{split}.parquet"
        process_split(input_path, output_path)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
